answer_1.quote: We introduce Exemplar-Based Expository Text Generation, a novel task that generates an expository text on a new topic by leveraging an exemplar from a similar topic...
answer_1.outputs: Long-form expository texts (paragraphs or multi-paragraph passages) describing the target topic

answer_2.quote: We use well-established metrics commonly used in previous research, namely ROUGE, BLEU, and METEOR. ... We also compute the percentage of hallucinated tokens (Halluc.) and NLI‑E / NLI‑C for factuality.

answer_3.quote: We leverage LLMs to evaluate Imitativeness and Adaptiveness... The LLM‑judge provides ratings from 1 to 5 for each aspect and we measure agreement with human annotators.
methods: rating on a 1‑5 scale per aspect

answer_4.quote: We recruited three expert human annotators... to evaluate model outputs using the same instructions given to the LLMs... Each model output was evaluated based on two criteria: Imitativeness and Adaptiveness.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were given the same evaluation instructions as the LLM judges, rating each output on Imitativeness and Adaptiveness.
